definitions.explanation: Two or more people putting their names together on one document, letter or gift, as joint senders.

examples.japanese: {連名|れんめい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: To send a letter signed by several people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧{連名|れんめい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: We sent New Year's cards in both our names as a couple.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{連名|れんめい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{要望書|ようぼうしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}し→出す：01087_dasu⟧、⟦{横断歩道|おうだんほどう}→横断歩道：06502_oudanhodou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めた→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: The residents sent the city a jointly signed request asking for a crosswalk.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連名|れんめい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: jointly, in the names of several people
- ⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧{連名|れんめい}: in the names of husband and wife
- {連名|れんめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧: a jointly signed letter

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with the homophone ⟦{連盟|れんめい}→連盟：23112_renmei⟧ (league, federation).
